collection.title: Citroen C3 Picasso 2010 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen C3 Picasso 2010 to 2017 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this C3 Picasso which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
